content.title: Cracker Barrel Investors Vote to Keep On CEO, but Send Message of Discontent
content.summary: Cracker Barrel shareholders voted to retain the company’s embattled chief executive after a calamitous rebranding campaign, but sent a clear message of discontent.  Board member  Gilbert Dávila,  a longtime marketing and diversity specialist, didn’t receive the necessary votes to stay on the board and has resigned, the company said.  Masino and Dávila both had been targeted by activist efforts after the chain’s logo change and restaurant remodels set off a political firestorm over the summer.
